messages:
leo: Quick alert — nightly billing run produced two draft invoices for RazorTech and the GPU charge is missing on both. Also the reserved/on-demand split applied incorrectly (60/40 vs expected 80/20). Logs attached. :grimacing:

emily: which batch id?

leo: batch=2026-03-22-outer-3. Log snippet:

```
[2026-03-22T23:45:02Z] batch-outer-3: aggregate(metric=gpu_hours) tenant=razortech sum=0
[2026-03-22T23:45:02Z] batch-outer-3: commitment_split -> applied {reserved:0.6,on_demand:0.4} expected {reserved:0.8}
[2026-03-22T23:45:03Z] invoice-gen: wrote draft id=inv-draft-5555
[2026-03-22T23:45:03Z] invoice-gen: wrote draft id=inv-draft-5556
```

harry: Raw usage shows gpu_hours rows for the month window — they exist. So aggregator dropped them. Any recent ETL/partition changes?

leo: Yes — infra team deployed a partition-key optimization last night swapping tenant_id -> billing_key_normalized. Aggregator logged: WARN: partition missing for NULL billing_key_normalized.

nora: That would explain missing GPU rows. Why two drafts though? Invoice-gen should be single-writer per batch.

emily: I see a redis reconnect around 23:45:01Z: `redis: multi/exec read timeout` — two workers both believed they held the lease and wrote drafts.

zoe: Immediate remediation: void inv-draft-5556, patch inv-draft-5555 to add GPU line and correct commitment split. Who can run the patch?

leo: I can. Plan: 1) void duplicate draft, 2) fetch draft payload and append GPU_HOURS line, 3) correct reserved split metadata, 4) record audit note. Manual commands (sanitized):

```
# fetch draft
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING" https://billing.internal/invoices/inv-draft-5555 > /tmp/draft.json
# compute gpu charge: 210h * $28/hr = $5880
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"invoice_id":"inv-draft-5555","ops":[{"op":"add_line","code":"GPU_HOURS","qty":210,"amount_cents":588000},{"op":"update_meta","field":"reserved_split","value":0.8}]}' https://billing.internal/admin/patch
```

harry: I'll void inv-draft-5556 and tag it "void: duplicate_leader_write". Also adding a small reconciliation alert: after invoice generation, ensure required metrics (gpu_hours) present for any tenant with reserved capacity.

nora: Infra will roll back the partition-key change and add a canary test inserting a null normalized key to catch this. Also will add a DB-level view that includes default partition so aggregator won't miss rows.

emily: Devs should harden invoice-gen idempotency: write lease + invoice marker atomically (redis lua or DB lock) and treat lease renewal failures as fatal for leader election. I'll own that PR. ETA tomorrow EOD.

billing-bot: Incident created: BIL-2026-150. Severity: P2. Assigned: finance oncall.

leo: Patch applied at 23:58Z, inv-draft-5556 voided. Logging the manual edit in audit notes. Will follow up once partition rollback and reconciliation run finish. Closing loop when reconciliation shows zero drift for RazorTech.
